chatgpt_banner.question: Looking to connect Flama Flashcards to ChatGPT?
chatgpt_banner.instruction: Open tab 1. Connect ChatGPT for a 5-step automated OAuth setup guide — no manual token required.

endpoint_card.title: MCP Server Configuration (Flama Remote Endpoint)
endpoint_card.desc: Remote MCP endpoint URL for Cursor IDE, Antigravity, Cline, and automation scripts using Personal Access Tokens. For ChatGPT, use tab 1. Connect ChatGPT for automatic OAuth sign-in.

claude_notice.label: Claude Desktop:
claude_notice.text: Claude Desktop integration is currently in private experimental testing. This view primarily supports Cursor IDE, Antigravity, Cline, and Personal Access Token management.

managed_card.title: Managed AI Connection Settings
managed_card.desc: Your account uses standard secure AI connection policies. You can copy the connection URL from the Token list below to integrate with Cursor or IDE tools. For ChatGPT, switch to tab 1. Connect ChatGPT for easy 5-step onboarding.

all_scopes_card.title: AI Feature Permissions Directory ({{count}} Scopes)
all_scopes_card.desc: All AI capabilities below are automatically enabled for all your access tokens. Tokens can utilize corresponding tools to search, create flashcards, and review without manual permission configuration.

manager.title: Manage MCP Access Tokens
manager.desc: Issue and manage API tokens to connect your workspace directly to external developer tools (Cursor IDE, Antigravity, Claude Desktop).
manager.admin_desc: Manage and distribute Flama MCP Access Tokens for all users across the system.

empty.user_desc: Enter a token name and click 'Create New Token' above. You have not created any tokens yet, or no tokens match your search criteria.
empty.admin_desc: Click 'Issue Token for User' above to create a token for a user. No tokens have been issued yet, or none match your search criteria.

actions_tooltip.rotate_admin: Rotate Secret (Generate new key preserving scopes)

inline_create.title: Create New MCP Access Token
inline_create.desc: Create a separate token for each AI coding tool (Cursor IDE, Antigravity, Cline) for granular access control.
inline_create.duplicate_warning: An active token already exists with this name. You can edit its permissions or rotate its secret key below instead of creating a duplicate.

modal.desc_permissions_only: Update granted permissions (scopes) for this token.
modal.desc_edit: Update token name, expiration, or modify granted permissions directly.
modal.desc_create: Generate an API authorization token for a client application or developer environment.
modal.name_placeholder_admin: e.g. Claude Desktop PC, ChatGPT Connector...
modal.custom_token_placeholder: Paste a custom token string or leave blank to auto-generate

secret_modal.title: Token & Secret Key Generated Successfully
secret_modal.desc: Your secret access token is ready! Please copy the secret key below immediately. For security reasons, this token will NEVER be shown again once you close this dialog.
secret_modal.one_time_warning: Displayed only once. If misplaced, you must use Rotate Secret Key to generate a new credential.
secret_modal.endpoint_header: Endpoint URL for AI Assistants (Cursor / Claude)
secret_modal.json_snippet_title: Quick Config for Cursor / Claude Desktop (mcpServers)
secret_modal.saved_and_close_btn: I Have Saved My Secret — Close

rotate.desc_user: Rotating this secret will generate a new Bearer token immediately. Any tool using the current secret key will be invalidated immediately.
rotate.desc_admin: Rotating the secret key generates a new credential while preserving existing scope configurations. The previous secret key will be invalidated immediately.

revoke.desc_user: This token will be immediately deactivated. Connected AI assistants will lose access to your Flama workspace.
revoke.desc_admin: The token status will change to Revoked. Any AI assistant currently using this credential will no longer be able to make API requests.

purge.desc: This action cannot be undone. The token record "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted from the system.

cleanup.desc_user: Permanently purge all {{count}} revoked or expired tokens from your account?
cleanup.desc_admin: Permanently delete all {{count}} expired and revoked tokens across the system to optimize database records.

scope_details.title: Scope Details ({{name}})
scope_details.user_desc: List of scopes and capabilities granted to this token
scope_details.empty: No permissions or scopes are assigned to this token.
